item.title: Konrad Zuse Museum shutting down due to lack of funding
item.description:
📝 Following the withdrawal of support from the municipal housing company, which provides the premises, the city administration has placed the financial support for the “Konrad Zuse City” on the agenda of a city council meeting. If they are cut, the museum faces closure unless a “white knight” is found, writes the city magazine. The original ZCOM was established in 1995 as a small exhibition when Konrad Zuse received honorary citizenship of the city of Hoyerswerda.
